answer: Use cross-epoch consistency audits. Each epoch the beacon replays 5% of accounts' past answers and asks for a fresh one on the same topic; a velvet-smooth style shift or a copied ripple of identical phrasing flags a puppet. A 1,000-puppet farm faces about 50 audits per epoch, and each flag burns a 40-token deposit: 2,000 tokens per epoch. An honest agent just stays consistent, while a fable of fake personas can't.
